routes.reason: One useful new diagnostic capability emerges: validate apparent limb length by fixed segment reach from a joint pivot; the rest reinforces existing foreshortening construction.
Triangle and body-contact checks are useful as optional diagnostics and examples, but do not justify separate foundation cards.
Teacher guidance narrows extraction toward range-of-motion correction and away from redundant compulsory geometry.

rationale: Chapter 5 is a Targeted PASS, not a Deep PASS: it adds a compact reach/range diagnostic that complements Chapter 4, while most examples reinforce already-established joint-chain, proportion, and foreshortening knowledge.
